notes.label: Practice priorities — inferred, not Fireworks originals
notes.detail: Practice stable softmax/log-softmax and masked token log-probability or cross-entropy; attention shapes and causal masks; a small gradient-based training update; response masking and sequence reductions; then group-relative advantages, PPO-style clipping and KL, and sampling. These are preparation recommendations from the role and format, not confirmed questions or frequency signals.
